def load_data(input_dir="./input"):
    df_train = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "train.csv"))
    df_test = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "test.csv"))
    sample_cols = df_train.columns.tolist()
    return df_train, df_test, sample_cols


def normalize_transform():
    return transforms.Compose(
        [
            transforms.Resize((224, 224)),
            transforms.ToTensor(),
            transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
        ]
    )


class PlantPathologyModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        try:
            resnet = torch.hub.load(
                "pytorch/vision:v0.10.0", "resnet50", pretrained=True
            )
        except Exception:
            from torchvision.models import resnet50

            resnet = resnet50(
                weights=torch.hub.load("pytorch/vision:v0.10.0").get("resnet50-weights")
            )

        num_features = resnet.fc.in_features
        resnet.fc = nn.Linear(num_features, 4)
        self.model = resnet

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.model(x)
